SLICE PLAN for the remaining 35 sites, recorded as a NOTE rather than as open beads so the queue is not inflated with work nobody is doing. Cut each slice bead only when an actor is ready to take it; the scoping is done here so that costs nothing later.

SLICE 2 - core (7): StorySource (atlas.scala:71), SpanSet (span.scala:71), TextSpan (span.scala:11), TokenRange (surface.scala:37), Credence (ids.scala:142), ClaimMeta (claim.scala:45), AudioSpan (transcript.scala:29). Do this SECOND after embed-core: core is the foundation every other module depends on, so its reference scope is the whole build and it is the slice most likely to surface cross-module breakage. Expect the widest gate of any slice.
SLICE 3 - align (4 remaining: AlignmentRow matrix.scala:116, AlignmentMatrix matrix.scala:229, HsmmConfig hsmm.scala:83, CostWeights cost.scala:33) plus features (Coverage estimate.scala:102, NarrativeWindowPlan derivation.scala:126) plus embed-grakern (StructuralProgram distance.scala:53). PopulationAggregate is DONE (52c2bbe) and is the reference shape. NOTE Coverage: it is the support carrier ADR 0003 leans on, so forging one forges the support figure attached to every estimate that carries it.
SLICE 4 - view (13, the largest): ProjectionContract/Extent/Anchor/SceneNavigation (atlas.scala 53/163/194/308), CommonViewState/ChannelBudget/LanePolicy/CodexSpec (compiler.scala 105/139/175/235), ViewProvenance/SourceRun/TextAnnotation/NavigationIndex/CodexFlow (codex.scala 67/154/166/295/361). REFERENCE SCOPE INCLUDES THE SIBLING REPO: storyatlas4s consumes view, so rule 3's sibling-seam check applies - compile AND run its suite.
SLICE 5 - document (5) plus interview (3) plus acquire (4).

RANKING PRINCIPLE, CORRECTED, and it must be applied within every remaining slice: rank by WHAT THE TYPE GUARDS, not by whether it validates ITSELF. The chief's original heuristic scored each type by whether its companion held a smart constructor returning Either/Option, and that heuristic is blind to a type validated by an EXTERNAL gate - which is how AuthorizedRemoteRequest, whose guarantee is enforced by RemotePolicy.evaluate in a different object, got ranked below four arithmetic types despite being the privacy boundary for whether participant text leaves the machine. Before ordering any slice, grep for who CONSTRUCTS each type, not just what its companion contains. Authorization and privacy types first, identity second, estimand carriers third, arithmetic fourth.
